content.short: Niche Club is a new take on social media, distributing ownership of the network to its members.
content.description: Founded in 2022, Niche Club reimagines social media as a distributed network of its members. By removing centralized control of data and traditional ad-selling, it rewards interactions and content creation with tokens. Each club issues its own unique token that accrues real value over time and can be used for commerce, event admission, and membership status. These tokens can also be exchanged for real currency. The system rewards genuine engagement and supports vibrant communities.
content.meta: Niche Club is a Web3 social app that distributes ownership to its members. Discover Niche Club and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
